inlines.v: HON'ESTY, noun on'esty. [Latin honestas.] 1. In principle, an upright disposition; moral rectitude of heart; a disposition to conform to justice and correct moral principles, in all social transactions. In fact, upright conduct; an actual conformity to justice and moral rectitude. 2. Fairness; candor; truth; as the honesty of a narrative. 3. Frank sincerity. Honesty is chiefly applicable to social transactions, or mutual dealings in the exchange of property.
